conviction_note: A non-result, leaning very slightly long. The evidence is mostly macro and industry proxies that point both ways. On the negative side: the Q3 bond rout (10y up 87bp to 5.29%) marks down fixed-income AUM, and iShares flows ran below Q2's record pace on ETFGI data. On the positive side: average AUM stepped up about 5-6% QoQ (Invesco proxy, already in the consensus fee line), IBIT and money-market assets rose, HLEND redemption requests eased, the Aligned close fell in the quarter and there is a small Securitize mark. Against all that sit a 4-of-4 positive reaction history, a mildly upside-paid skew and a stock that lagged SPY by about 5 points since July. Nothing found is a company-level number the market has not seen, so p_up 53 on abs 4.8 gives +0.29. The finding sum is +0.35, and the two agree.
bar: Q3 2026 adjusted EPS consensus $14.28 (TickerLeague, 9 analysts, range $13.63-$14.95, https://tickerleague.com/companies/BLK/estimates via search snippet) and $14.31 (AAII, 15 analysts, published 2026-10-13, https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/514979-what-you-need-to-know-about-blackrock-incs-q3-earnings). These two agree. Zacks preview: EPS +21.6% y/y on $11.55 (about $14.04), revenue +14.5% y/y (about $7.45B on Q3 2025's $6.51B), AUM consensus $15.67T, advisory/admin/securities-lending fees $6.02B against Q2's $5.7B. The Zacks figures come from a search snippet and their publication date is not verified. No company guidance on the quarter beyond a full-year adjusted margin of 45% or more, mid-single-digit G&A growth and buybacks of at least $550M a quarter (Q2 call, https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-15-blackrock-inc-stock/). Beat history: Q2 $13.91 vs about $12.69 (+9.6%), Q1 $12.53 vs $11.46 (+9.3%). The print_vs_bar of +3% is on EPS.
positioning_check: Short interest on the 2026-09-30 FINRA settlement was 2,040,215 shares, flat against 09-15 (2,040,079), days to cover 3.61 (equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/blk/short-interest, fetched 2026-10-13). That is roughly 1.3% of BLK's ~155M shares (share count not verified on that page), so not a crowded short. Baseline 25-delta skew is -3.29 vol points (calls bid over puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.65, event-implied move 4.52%, straddle 4.74%. The stock is -10.7% from its 52-week high, +1.47% over 20 days, -0.49% over 5 days, and -1.8% since the 2026-07-15 print against SPY +3.0% (AAII). All four reactions in the baseline were up (+6.63, +3.02, +5.93, +3.39; median 4.66).

findings.finding: Q3 2026 was a historic bond rout and a narrow equity quarter. The 10-year Treasury yield rose 87bp to 5.29%, the worst quarter since 1994, and TLT fell 10%; the Fed hiked 25bp in September. S&P 500 +2.3%, Russell small caps -7.2%, MSCI EAFE +0.9%, MSCI EM -0.2%, REITs -6.0%. Market impact on BLK's mix (roughly a quarter to a third fixed income) is therefore about flat to slightly negative. So ending AUM is likely about $15.3T plus flows (about $15.45-15.5T), against a Zacks consensus AUM of $15.67T if that figure is current. A softer ending AUM also lowers the Q4 base-fee run-rate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BLK has not been sold on AUM marks alone in the baseline; the four reactions (all up) were driven by flows, organic base-fee growth and EPS beats. July 2025 (outside the baseline window, previous CIK) fell about 5-6% on a revenue miss and a $52B single-client index redemption, so a headline-flow or AUM disappointment has been sold before.
findings.why_not_priced: The macro is fully public, and analysts usually mark AUM to quarter-end markets. The open question is whether the $15.67T Zacks AUM consensus (date unverified) was updated for the September bond selloff. If it had been fully priced, we would expect BLK to have underperformed SPY since July, and it has, by about 4.8 points (AAII). So much of this is likely already in the price.
findings.independence: Index returns from a different source: https://novelinvestor.com/2026-q3-returns/ (S&P +2.3%, small cap -7.2%, EAFE +0.9%, EM -0.2%, REITs -6.0%). Fed hike and 10y highest since 2007: https://www.advisorperspectives.com/dshort/updates/2026/10/01/10-year-treasury-yield-long-term-perspective-september-2026. Counter-evidence: Invesco's month-end AUM rose 2.7% over Q3 ($2,470.3B to $2,537.8B), https://finviz.com/news/400763/invesco-ltd-announces-september-30-2026-assets-under-management. This is a macro-to-company proxy that the company has not confirmed.

findings.finding: iShares flows ran below Q2's record pace in Q3 on ETFGI data. iShares' global YTD net inflows were $370.26B at end-July and $410.51B at end-August, so August was $40.25B, about 16% of $248.15B global ETF inflows, while Vanguard took $67.76B and led both month and YTD. BLK's own Q2 ETF inflows were $178B (about $59B a month) of $192B total net inflows. Q3 headline net inflows and organic base-fee growth (8% in Q2, 10% TTM, the line the stock traded on in July) may therefore print below Q2. The broader US ETF industry stayed strong: July $193B, August $182.6B, September $140.9B.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: July 2026 +6.63% on $192B inflows and 8% organic base-fee growth (sweep row, citing BLK's Q2 release). July 2025 fell about 5% when net inflows missed on a $52B low-fee index redemption. Flows are the line this stock trades on.
findings.why_not_priced: ETFGI's monthly provider flows are not BLK's reported numbers. Their definitions differ (global listings, no institutional index or active mutual funds), and September iShares data was not found, so analysts may not anchor on them. If the market had priced a flow slowdown, the skew would not lean to calls and the stock would not have bounced +1.47% over 20 days. The upside-paid skew says positioning expects another strong flow print.
findings.independence: ETFGI July report (iShares YTD $370.26B, Vanguard $372.93B): https://mondovisione.com/news/etfgi-reports-global-etf-industry-assets-reach-record-us-2311-trillion-at-the-2026820/. Counter-series: FactSet US ETF flows, September $140.9B against August $182.6B, YTD a record above $1.5T, https://insight.factset.com/u.s.-etf-monthly-summary-september-2026-results; Trackinsight has iShares leading issuers in the week of Sept 14-18 at $29.74B (via wealthprofessional.ca snippet). This is a proxy, and the broad series points to industry strength.

findings.finding: Average AUM stepped up about 5-6% QoQ. Invesco's preliminary Q3 average AUM was $2,510.2B against a Q2 average of $2,368.8B (+6.0%), because Q2 ended far above its average (Invesco's Q2 ending AUM was +14.4% against average AUM +6.8%). BLK's Q2 also ended at a record $15.3T after a strong quarter. So BLK's Q3 average AUM (and base fees, with one extra day) should be about 5% above Q2. The Zacks consensus for advisory/admin/securities-lending fees is $6.02B against Q2's $5.7B (+5.6%), which already embeds this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: BLK has beaten EPS by about 9-10% on each of the last two prints (Q1 $12.53 vs $11.46, Q2 $13.91 vs $12.69), with reactions of +3.02% and +6.63%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: consensus EPS is $14.28-14.31, +2.7% on Q2's $13.91, and the fee consensus is +5.6% QoQ. The residual is operating leverage on a +5% fee base against mid-single-digit G&A growth. If it were fully priced, the consensus would sit nearer Q2 plus the full fee increase at a 45%+ margin, roughly $14.6-14.9.
findings.independence: Invesco Q2 average AUM $2,368.8B: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000914208/000091420826000207/ivzaumexhibit991-0626.htm (the same issuer, so this shares a source). JPMorgan AWM Q3 2026 net revenue rose only +1% QoQ ($6,909M vs $6,851M), and asset-management fees were $4.41B, +14% y/y: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0000019617/000162828026065582/a3q26erfex992supplement.htm. That is a mild counterpoint from a peer that has already reported.

findings.finding: Securitize mark-to-market. BLK said on the Q2 call it would mark its 7.3M Securitize shares through investment income from Q3. SECZ debuted on 2026-07-02 at $12.30 (pre-merger reference $11.78) and closed 2026-09-30 at $14.59. That is a nonoperating gain of about $17-20M, about $0.08-0.10 a share pre-tax, on a $14.28 bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history; nonoperating marks have not been cited as drivers of BLK's reactions.
findings.why_not_priced: Too small for anyone to model explicitly, and it is below operating income with no path to guidance, so it is sized at a fraction.
findings.independence: Q2 call mention of marking the 7.3M Securitize shares: https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-15-blackrock-inc-stock/. Debut close $12.30: https://en.fnnews.com/news/202607031653028350.

findings.finding: IBIT and digital assets grew sharply in Q3. IBIT net assets were about $47.2B on 2026-07-14 (BlackRock UAE page; about $43.4B at end-June per an unverified secondary source), $58.8B on 2026-08-21 and $66.79B on 2026-09-28. US spot bitcoin ETFs had $3.52B of August inflows, their strongest month of 2026. At a 0.25% fee that is roughly +$5-10M of quarterly fees and positive digital-asset flows in the release.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None isolated; digital assets are a small fee line.
findings.why_not_priced: Public daily data and immaterial to EPS. It is filed because it adds to headline flows.
findings.independence: IBIT net assets as of Jul 14 and Aug 21: https://www.blackrock.com/ae/intermediaries/products/333011/ishares-bitcoin-trust-etf (search snippet). The ETF and AUM proxies above share no document with this.

findings.finding: Private-credit redemption pressure eased. Q3 redemption requests at HPS Corporate Lending Fund (HLEND) fell to about 11.5% of shares from 13.3% in Q2, per a 2026-09-11 filing; the tender stayed capped at 5% (about $600M). This follows the March-April 2026 gate that weighed on the stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock fell about 12-14% from its peak in spring 2026 amid HPS redemption-gate headlines, then rose +3.02% on Q1 and +6.63% on Q2 as flows reassured.
findings.why_not_priced: Public since Sept 11, so largely priced. Any residual is in management confirming private-markets net flows and fundraising (target $400B gross 2025-2030) on the call.
findings.independence: Reuters via KFGO: https://kfgo.com/2026/09/11/blackrock-private-credit-fund-redemptions-fall-in-third-quarter/ (same filing, so one fact).

findings.finding: GIP's $40B Aligned Data Centers acquisition with AIP and MGX closed 2026-07-21, inside Q3. The deal can generate transaction fees and fee-paying AUM for the infrastructure platform in the reported quarter.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue +31% y/y cited HPS transaction fees as a contributor; the stock rose +6.63%.
findings.why_not_priced: Management flagged on the Q2 call that it would close 'in the coming weeks', so the timing is modelled. The size of any transaction fee is not public, and that is the residual.

findings.finding: Money-market fund assets hit records in Q3 (ICI: about $7.98T in the week to 2026-09-02, +$44.75B in the week) as the Fed moved to hike. That is a tailwind for BLK's cash-management flows, which sit inside total net inflows.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cash flows are low-fee and rarely the driver of BLK's reaction.
findings.why_not_priced: Public weekly data, low fee rate. Counterpoint: Invesco had September money-market outflows of $5.7B.
findings.independence: Invesco September liquidity outflows of $5.7B point the other way: https://finviz.com/news/400763/invesco-ltd-announces-september-30-2026-assets-under-management.

findings.finding: Positioning into the print is not stretched. The stock is -1.8% since the 07-15 print against SPY +3.0% and -10.7% from its 52-week high. Skew is upside-paid (-3.29 vol points), short interest is flat at 2.04M shares (3.6 days to cover), and all four prior reactions on this CIK were positive (median 4.66%).
findings.why_not_priced: The underperformance partly reflects the bond-rout macro in finding 1, so this overlaps it. That overlap is why it is small. A stretched long would show as a strong 20-day run-up and rich call skew; neither is extreme here.
findings.independence: Short interest: https://equibles.com/stocks/blk/short-interest. Skew and reaction history: sealed baseline. This shares the macro cause with finding 1.

baseline_tension: Mixed. My two small negatives (bond-rout AUM marks, slower iShares pace) cut against the mildly upside-paid skew and the 4-of-4 positive reaction history. The positives agree with it. Net, the findings neither confirm nor fight the options market, which is why p_up sits near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 7 (sign against skew): the two negatives sit against an upside-paid skew (-3.29) and a non-crowded short with no specific reason the options market is wrong, so the bond-rout AUM finding went -0.6 to -0.4 and the iShares-pace finding -0.5 to -0.4; p_up moved from 52 to 53.
Rule 2 (one-offs at a fraction): the Securitize nonoperating mark went +0.1 to +0.05.
Rule 5 (proxy vs broad series): the iShares ETFGI proxy is kept small, and the broader FactSet industry-flow series that points the other way is now cited inside it; no size change beyond rule 7.
Rule 6 (bar): the bar was confirmed by two agreeing sources ($14.28 / $14.31), so no cap applied.
Pessimism artefact note: the negatives were not added to by searching harder for bad news; positives filed at parity.
